## What and why

## Checklist
- [ ] No SDK content (headers, libraries, PDBs, documentation text), no title binaries, keys or dumps
- [ ] New layouts, constants or behaviour have a row in `docs/provenance.md` (source, method, date)
- [ ] SPDX tag in every new file (AGPL-3.0-or-later for `src/`, MIT for tools and tests)
- [ ] No title-specific offsets or patches in code
- [ ] `tools/check-files` passes
- [ ] Tested on: GPU / driver / OS (and Wine + vkd3d-proton version on Linux)
- [ ] AI-assisted: yes / no
